value.kbd_note: click a window (SELECT focus) then type — keyboard reaches X regardless of pointer position. Framebuffer-proven (whoami -> guest). Also drivable via labctl exec sunos414.
value.note: relative Sun serial mouse, cursor_scale 1.0 (operator eyeball pending). Non-priv guest autologs into OpenWindows via console getty->login->~/.login->gallery-session; xnews must own the console tty (TT=console) or input is dead, and ~/.Xdefaults sets SetInput: select (click-to-focus) so keyboard reaches X with the pointer anywhere. Foreign-arch TCG station on /opt/qemu-sparc. exec = telnet_unix_e over in-guest telnetd.

labctl.notes: OpenWindows 3 desktop as the unprivileged guest, restored via loadvm golden. Mouse and keyboard both work (keyboard needs SetInput: select click-to-focus, baked in the golden's ~/.Xdefaults; with followmouse keys only land while the pointer is over the window). exec = telnet_unix_e: labctl exec sunos414 over in.telnetd at 127.0.0.1:5947 (launcher re-adds the SLIRP hostfwd each start; client /root/sunexec.py).

render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# sunos414 (slot 147) — SunOS 4.1.4 / OpenWindows 3 on a SPARCstation 5 (sun4m):
#   qemu-system-sparc from the kernel-hive QEMU fork, installed to /opt/qemu-sparc
#   (pve-qemu ships no sparc target). TCG only, no KVM. cg3 framebuffer (SunOS
#   has no TCX driver), 64 MB (256 traps at boot), sd0=SCSI 3, sr0=SCSI 6 with
#   512-byte CD blocks. RELATIVE Sun serial mouse (dbus-rel). DARK LAUNCH:
#   listing=hidden while the install runs on camera; SH_IDLE_PAUSE_SECS=0 until
#   the golden exists.

museum.blurb: Sun’s BSD-derived UNIX wearing OpenLook — the beveled, pinnable OpenWindows desktop Sun shipped before CDE won the toolkit war.
museum.notes: The other branch of Sun's desktop history next to the CDE solaris station: same vendor, same SPARC, OPEN LOOK instead of Motif. Auto-logs into OpenWindows as an unprivileged guest; mouse + keyboard both work (click-to-focus). sun4m under TCG on a standalone qemu-system-sparc build; loadvm golden restore.

notes: listed 2026-08-18: OpenWindows desktop as unprivileged guest, loadvm golden, mouse + keyboard working

keyboard-in-X fix: SetInput: select (click-to-focus) in guest ~/.Xdefaults + openwin owns console tty; under the default followmouse the keyboard only reached a window under the pointer, reading as dead. Diagnosed by two competing agents (guest-config vs QEMU-escc); escc ruled out, guest-config won.
slot 147/UDP 54147; exec telnet_unix_e on 5947; media is a BIN converted to 2048-byte sunos414.iso

reset.fixture: OpenWindows 3 desktop on SunOS 4.1.4 as the UNPRIVILEGED guest user (csh prompt sunos414%, File Manager on /export/home/guest): cmdtool console, File Manager, and the 'Introducing Your Sun Desktop' Help Viewer over the cg3 at 1024x768x8 (SPARCstation 5 under TCG). Mouse PASS and Keyboard PASS, both framebuffer-proven and surviving loadvm restore. Input works because openwin owns the console tty (xnews TT=console) AND ~/.Xdefaults sets OpenWindows.SetInput: select (click-to-focus) — with the default followmouse, keys only reach a window while the pointer is physically over it, which reads as a dead keyboard. loadvm restores the logged-in desktop instantly; the guest starts frozen until the first visitor.
